reviews.review:
I started playing this game and at first it was fun.
But the more i played it and the more enemies where on the map, the more frustrating it got.

You can't fire any weapon over a fence or between a small gap.
You need to jump to get the shot over the fence . The Hitboxes are just set up very bad.
Maybe its because of the camera angle but as it is now, it is bad.

The level design is repetive.
Why 7 levels when only 3-4 Tilesets are used per stage?

Then i also have this bug, that sometimes the weapon is shooting even when i did not press anything.
Sometimes it instalnty shoots when i Reload...
This is extremely frustrating when using the bow and then suddenly you position is fixed because the bow starts to charge the shot.

On the hardest difficulty there are many enemies and they do ridicules damage.
2 hits and the full armor bar is gone.
Its difficult to hit the enemies because all the shots somehow get soacked up in the Environment.

So i can't recommend this game.

The base ideas are not bad and at the beginning it was new and it player ok. Some things felt strange but which game doesn't?
The problem start when you play more and more and you see all the parts which (to me) feel unpolished. To name a few:
- Level design - it is very repetitive and forgettable.
- Aiming - sometimes you aim at something but the bullet // arrow goes somewhere completely different (I am looking at you bow) (most likely caused by camera?)
- Hitboxes of environment - shooting a bow can be very frustrating when you are unable to hit an enemy because the shot is "caught" by a fence or a lightpost and you (as in the player) are confused why? This could have something to do with the camera (3rd person) or the hitboxes - not sure.
- The last 2 "areas" before the final boss - it hurts me playing them because of all the effects going on. Those are simply too much.
- Weapons - it feels like there are a few you can really use - the rest (at least it feels that way) are useless. 
- Augments - they don't allow to have real gameplay combinations because the way it is setup you have to use few of those (and bring them to a high level). Also they don't change the play style that much to be honest. (Compared to other games which allow for much greater variations).

In the end I cannot recommended this game to anyone.

It was kind of tragic honestly. The bullets require you to lead about 10 seconds ahead of the enemy because the travel time is so bad.  The guns were basically all the same. Ranging from an smg to a shotgun. The challenges are the same all through out and the map never changed after playing through 5 sections. Not only were the challenges the same, but for the "kill enemies using only melee" in one part of the map it would be a waiting period of 5 to 10 seconds for enemies to spawn. You have to get 20 kills and have 30 seconds, I believe. Only played for 52 mins, so I can not remember. Either way, the amount of time it takes for the enemies to spawn and the time allotted for the challenge is not balanced. The game was alright. Just not my cup of tea.

this is by far one of the worst games I've ever played..

the movement is slow AF, the gun play is absolutely terrible, I don't want to lead my target by 10 seconds while I wait for bullet travel time to meander its way there.

WAY too much "cyber" colors going on, it just muddies everything down and just quickly becomes an irritating environment to play in

AND DON"T GIVE ME A CHALLENGE TO KILL 20 ENEMIES WITH MELEE AND THEN NOT SPAWN IN ENOUGH TO KILL WITHIN THE TIME LIMIT!!!!!!

Frequent crashes with an unreal error that just says fatal error no codes or anything, it's the only game in my library I've seen this error on and it can occur after a few minutes to a few hours making the game unplayable.
